brief: Explicitly remove Roki identity; larger clear avatars recognizable from a distance through distinct silhouettes and saturated colors.
sizeIntent: Visible artwork +25–30%, tighter 85–90% frame occupancy; roughly 52–56px sidebar and 44–48px message design targets.

directions.name: Bold Companions
directions.summary: Saturated sculpted companions with four unmistakable silhouettes
directions.prompt:
Use case: UI mockup / precise avatar replacement and enlargement.
The user APPROVES the supplied pearl/fluid Hermes Studio UI. They now EXPLICITLY say REMOVE ROKI; it is not required. They want avatars that are CLEAR, DISTINCT FROM A DISTANCE, and A LITTLE BIGGER. This instruction overrides all earlier Roki identity preservation.
INPUT IMAGE: approved desktop+phone pearl/fluid Hermes Studio conversation, EDIT TARGET and layout/style reference. Preserve its UI, but REPLACE EVERY ROKI PORTRAIT COMPLETELY. No stone, rock facets, recessed black visor, orange side insert, sneakers or Roki-like pentagonal hood may remain. We are designing a NEW non-Roki identity system.
OUTPUT: landscape 3:2 polished design comparison board. Upper approximately 76% is the SAME desktop-left / phone-right application view from the input, with the new avatars at their intended larger UI scale. Bottom approximately 24% is a narrow clean white IDENTITY STRIP with four large avatars labelled Atlas, Nova, Scout, Echo, each beside one small sample. This strip helps judge silhouette and color; do not turn it into a mascot poster. Small concept number/family label at the edge. No physical hardware frames, unrelated illustrations or new interface layouts.
KEEP THE APPROVED UI: exact pearlescent white/soft blue/amber-light background, white-glass cards, thin regular type, existing text, left navigation, right Files/Memory widgets, current exchange, point-cloud activity disc, big pill composer and desktop/phone arrangement. No new fake results, metrics or task claims. The only main changes are replacing avatars, making them visibly bigger and minimally adjusting their immediate text padding if required.
LARGER, CLEARER AVATARS: enlarge the visible avatar artwork by about 25–30% relative to the reference, and the frame by about 10–15% where room allows. They must occupy 85–90% of their own tile/circle, not sit as a tiny object inside a huge white ring. Think approximately 52–56px sidebar portraits and 44–48px chat-message portraits at normal UI viewing scale, with the large bot-card examples around 80–96px. Keep body text layout readable and align portrait centers with the names. These are SIZE INTENT targets for the concept, not extra numbers to print in the UI.
CONSISTENT FOUR-BOT COLOR MAP in all families:
Atlas / Chief of staff = saturated COBALT BLUE #1467FF.
Nova / Creative partner = saturated CORAL RED #FF5149.
Scout / Research analyst = saturated EMERALD GREEN #00A96B.
Echo / Writing partner = saturated GOLDEN YELLOW / AMBER #FFBE1B.
Give each a DIFFERENT BIG SILHOUETTE so recognition does not rely on color alone. No tiny texture, fragile line art, low-contrast pastel avatars, transparency or optical noise. Strong opaque color masses, crisp outlines by shape contrast, clean material and no excessive padding. New avatars must match themselves in sidebar, message row, phone chat and bottom strip. Echo's main message portraits are yellow, not the old orange rock.
Do not invent animals, fish, plants, illustrated people, letters unless the individual brief asks for them, or elaborate toy bodies/props. No shoes or full-body mascot anywhere. The goal is recognizable mature teammate AVATARS that sit naturally in the approved pearl interface.

FAMILY 01 / BOLD COMPANIONS.
Create four very simple friendly SATIN-SCULPTED abstract heads, opaque saturated material with restrained smooth dimensional shading. No stone facets, black face panels or glass transparency. Their faces are two small calm DARK eyes directly on their colored body, with slight individual spacing. No mouth needed and no angry inward slant.
Atlas: COBALT BLUE broad U-shaped/doorway ARCH head with a flat stable base and large clear upper curve; eye marks on the broad upper bridge.
Nova: CORAL RED rounded DIAMOND head, taller than wide, softly clipped corners; eyes centrally placed.
Scout: EMERALD GREEN asymmetric stepped PENTAGON with one clearly clipped upper corner and a small flat base; friendly eyes sit on the solid broad front. Keep it visibly different from Roki: no dark inset face, no rock facets, no side insert.
Echo: GOLDEN YELLOW DOUBLE-LOBED horizontal head like two connected soft lobes, wide shallow silhouette; two calm dark eyes on its smooth front.
Each silhouette is iconic and filled with its main color; a very subtle satin highlight adds tactility. Mature friendly designed shapes, not kawaii blobs, baby toys, geometric robots in armor or creatures with ears/limbs. All four are clearly distinguishable from across a room and on the small phone portrait.

Atlas: COBALT BLUE upright DOORWAY LOOP, broad rectangular arch with a large simple open center.
Nova: CORAL RED four-point PINWHEEL, four short rounded blades rotating around a small solid hub, confident compact silhouette. It is an abstract geometric emblem, not a flower.
Scout: EMERALD GREEN thick folded CHEVRON / offset directional bracket, strong diagonal sweep and one central fold; no fine arrow outline.
Echo: GOLDEN AMBER INTERLOCKING DOUBLE LOOP, two broad linked rounded loops, wide horizontal silhouette with two clear counters.
Each fills its frame robustly and remains identifiable in monochrome and at small sizes. Use only a subtle fold shadow, no complex 3D chrome, glossy glare or weak thin strokes. The pearl UI remains calm while these bold identity marks provide instantly recognizable anchors.

FAMILY 03 / STUDIO MODULES.
Four tiny original friendly DEVICE-LIKE HEAD AVATARS with saturated opaque colored shells and SHALLOW LIGHT FACE PANELS. Precise rounded industrial design, minimal two dark eye marks and no glow. No heavy helmet, faceted rock, dark visor, antennas, knobs, props, arms, legs or sneakers. Their outline and proportions should be clearly different:
Atlas: wide COBALT BLUE upright rectangular module with a broad flat top and rounded lower corners; a large pale blue face panel.
Nova: tall CORAL RED tapered module with a gently narrower crown and wide lower section; pale coral face panel.
Scout: compact EMERALD GREEN offset module with an unmistakable small STEPPED crown and asymmetric top silhouette; pale green face panel.
Echo: GOLDEN YELLOW TWIN-PANEL module, two softly connected rounded halves forming a broad horizontal unit; pale yellow face area with calm dark eyes.
Colored shells must remain thick and dominant — at least one third of the visible avatar area — so they can be recognized from far away. Small neutral white UI tiles do not swallow the outline. Satin polycarbonate/enamel finish and simple broad highlights, not toy-like baby proportions. Clear visual identity compatible with the fluid white interface.
